statement: The proportion of SUID cases with health issues in the last 72 hours before death is higher among infants born preterm compared to those not born preterm.
rationale: This study will compare health issues within 72 hours prior to death among SUID cases based on preterm birth status using ncfrp_v51. The design allows for a case-only analysis without the need for a denominator source.
prior_art: None in the inputs; existing claims do not address the specific question about health issues in the last 72 hours before death among SUID cases by preterm birth status.
required_concepts: health issues in the last 72 hours before death
cannot_establish: The design cannot estimate incidence or rates, determine causality, or account for unmeasured confounders.
